records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Victor,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

draft.subject: Re: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Victor,

Thanks for the update -- happy to give you the space to decide, and I won't crowd your week.

One thing worth knowing while you evaluate: your bulk import question is still open with our team, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the piece that makes an evaluation feel real.

If it's useful, I'm glad to help you get one first project set up whenever you're ready.

Best,
Chidi
